3.text:
<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>How to use the
Gonzola:<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Two people are
required to ride.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Press the <C:0000,0003,FF4F4FFF>A <C:0000,0003,FFFFFFFF>and <C:0000,0003,7DFF00FF>B <C:0000,0003,FFFFFFFF>Buttons
at the right time.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Try to push the handle
when it's at the <C:0000,0003,00EAFFFF>very top<C:0000,0003,FFFFFFFF>.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Those with motion sickness
should not use the Gonzola.<C:0003,0001,>
